args.title: Fix issue 4405 in src/components/ExportButton.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The ExportButton component manages the export format state internally with React useState, defaulting to "csv". To remember the last-used export format, the file could be changed to persist the chosen format in localStorage or sessionStorage and read it on component mount, so the format menu keeps the last selection across page reloads.
